title: Kagamine Len — An Intriguing Exhibition〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I could ask you the same. Why are you sighing so much...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've been trying to copy the drawing from one of the postcards Mafuyu brought over, but I'm having a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I'm in the same situation.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm trying to draw something like the painting of this flower, but it's so hard.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
B-But... Rin, I think it's really good...
A lot better than mine to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, but it's still all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, how does a person learn to draw like this...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Art's so hard, but Ena...
She keeps trying and drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, did someone just come over...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, there you guys are...
Were you two drawing just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, while looking at some of your dad's paintings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu brought over some postcards from your dad's exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, we're trying to copy what's on them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, okay... I guess she beat me to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Remember when you came to see the exhibit and you both said you really liked that one painting?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Incidentally, there were a lot of postcards of it left at the end, so I decided to bring some over...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I thought you already got one.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, but...
Since you went through the trouble of bringing them over...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You don't need them, right?
So, we'll take them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really...? Alright, if you two insist.
I mean, that's sorta why I brought them over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are these the only reason you came over today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I also wanted to take a break. My art class doesn't start for a while, and I finished doing that rough sketch for N25.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've been trying really hard, but we haven't been able to figure out how to draw like your dad...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Teach you guys...?
I don't have much to offer. Plus, he and I have totally different styles...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We both want to do whatever we can to get better at drawing...
